context: Drafting an annual program for a national museum
purpose: Plan the program; teach 国立/千葉/２月/８月/１０月/１２月/男女/３つ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 国立美術館で、年間プログラムを組みました。
lines.en: I drew up the annual program for the national museum.
lines.style: organized planner presenting the lineup, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 千葉の本館で開催ですよね。
lines.en: Held at the Chiba main building, right?
lines.style: manager confirming the venue, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、２月は新春展、８月は夏の企画展です。
lines.en: Yes — a New Year show in February, summer feature in August.
lines.style: planner detailing the seasons, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: １０月と１２月にも特別展がありますね。
lines.en: There are special shows in October and December too.
lines.style: manager noting the full year, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 男女問わず、幅広い世代に楽しんでもらえます。
lines.en: Both men and women, all generations can enjoy it.
lines.style: planner stressing accessibility, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: テーマは３つの柱で構成されてるんですよね。
lines.en: The theme rests on three pillars, right?
lines.style: manager checking the structure, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ファミリー層も意識して、解説も丁寧に。
lines.en: Mindful of families too, with careful explanations.
lines.style: thoughtful planner adding nuance, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ３つのテーマが、それぞれ際立つように。
lines.en: So the three themes each stand out.
lines.style: manager affirming the design, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
